Queens Social Ride

Queens, NY · Flushing Meadows Corona Park · Social · Road

Queens Social Ride is a social and road group ride in Queens, NY. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from The Unisphere, Africa side, Flushing Meadows Corona Park. About 15–35 miles, 8–13 mph, social.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at @qns_social_ride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Queens Social Ride group ride

An all-volunteer Sunday ride through Queens and the rest of the city. Routes go up on Friday nights. The group says it is a social ride, not a peloton, and that all people are welcome. Helmet, spare tube and basic tools required.
